title: Sleep: Protect the Asset
coreMove: Treat sleep as strategic protection for judgment instead of the leftover hour after ambition is done spending the body.
sourcePressure: The chapter argues that sleep protects the human asset required for discernment, creativity, connection, and contribution.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would give generic sleep hygiene tips or moralize about getting eight hours.

exampleSpecs.audience: manager tempted to trade sleep for judgment-heavy overtime
exampleSpecs.stakes: fatigue can become a safety risk disguised as dedication
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She places the fatigue log beside the reroute board and hands off before her pattern recognition dulls.

exampleSpecs.domain: semiconductor fab equipment technician after repeated overnight alarms
exampleSpecs.stakes: depleted judgment may worsen precision maintenance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He reviews the miscalibrated wafer report beside his alarm history and changes the on-call rotation.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An alarm history printout lies under a wafer report.

exampleSpecs.domain: mountain guide deciding whether to lead a dawn summit push
exampleSpecs.audience: guide whose tired confidence could endanger clients
exampleSpecs.stakes: sleep protects route judgment more than bravado does
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She sets the sleepless-night note beside the summit plan and cancels the dawn push before clients gear up.

exampleSpecs.domain: neonatal transport nurse before a long-distance transfer
exampleSpecs.stakes: capacity is a clinical asset, not personal comfort

exampleSpecs.domain: treaty translation team before final wording negotiations
exampleSpecs.stakes: one tired phrase can change legal meaning

exampleSpecs.firstImage: A treaty clause is highlighted beside reviewer initials.

exampleSpecs.domain: restaurant health inspector scheduling post-fire reopening inspections
exampleSpecs.audience: inspector whose overloaded schedule can miss hazards
exampleSpecs.stakes: sleep loss weakens public safety judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, he stacks inspections into midnight; after, he protects sleep before the gas-line review.
